author: J. C. Kemp
title: All Bamber Valley Elementary 3rd-graders participate in 2024-25 MCA math exam
text:
According to the Minnesota Department of Education , all third-graders at Bamber Valley Elementary School participated in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA, marking the highest rate among grade levels at the school.
The school tested 321 students in mathematics, with 105 of those in third grade.
Test results indicate 70% of third-grade students met math proficiency standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as statewide assessments to measure student achievement against Minnesota’s academic expectations and comply with federal and state regulations. The assessments include math, reading, and science, depending on grade level. Most students undergo the MCA, while the Alt MCA is available to students receiving special education who meet eligibility standards.
Minnesota’s Report Card shows that overall proficiency rates on the MCA have decreased compared to before the COVID-19 pandemic . In mathematics, proficiency dropped by over 7% since 2019, and reading proficiency declined nearly 5%.
